about: Labeled cases for tools/eval.ts. Retrieval queries name the corpus file and the section heading(s) that answer them; kind is lexical (shares words with the section) or paraphrase (says it differently). Sheets outside the default tag vocabulary (regex, task-scheduler, nginx, ffmpeg, winget, kubernetes) test that the tagger names new topics. Floors are regression floors set from the first real run, not targets.
